I01.scope: selection uses outer Source only; outer Support/Query excluded
I01.choice: maximum mean inner validation Macro-F1 per K; round12 ties prefer identity,bias,mean_anchor,full_refit
I01.outer_application: choose first, then reuse exact saved outer candidate endpoint
I01.limitation: smaller Source-only inner problems may not transport to target Support domain

I02.ranking_inputs: candidate spectra in frozen Source coordinates, Source scores and opaque hash keys; no candidate labels/Query
I02.ranking: nested label-blind order; diversity is max-min coverage anchored by the Source centroid; class counts revealed after all orders fixed
I02.full_refit: C10, Source-frozen scaler/gamma, class_weight None to hold per-point C fixed
I02.guarded_mean_anchor: sum-loss lambda=number selected; Identity fallback if any Support class missing
I02.reuse: complete/canonical historical subsets and repeated canonical ordered-ID objectives do not refit
I02.scope: candidate pool was historically class-stratified; only within-pool ranking is label-blind

I03.output_anchor: original OVR Source scores; no changed OVO argmax baseline
I03.lambda: sum loss N, equivalent to mean residual loss with unit ridge prior
I03.episodes: draw0/101/102, K1/3/5/10 nested; complete K10 only draw0
I03.negative_control: binary normalized feature Grams are algebraically equivalent; solver-coordinate fits are numerical controls, not independent algorithms
I03.basis_cost: Source feature-statistic/PCA fits recorded separately from spectral classifier and calibration fits

I04.same_ids: exact inherited H04 Support compositions and draws
I04.ESS: (sum weights)^2/sum squared weights; weight concentration, not independent physical sample count
I04.balanced_reuse: ESS=N gives equal lambda N; reuse prior G01 mean K5 endpoints
I04.heuristic_scope: prespecified extra shrinkage, not an optimized or universally valid rule
I04.legacy_plan_costs: inherited H04 plan fit-count fields are provenance only; current counts use executor/feasibility/sealed results

inference: Exploratory master TRAIN, all physical samples historically exposed; no new independent batch evidence or Query-based method selection

design_not_copied.scope: Compact display only; this derivative is not the original frozen protocol.
